2. This application has been filed for quashing of FIR of Kanti P.S. Case No. 05 of 2020 registered under Sections 341, 323, 498A, 379 and 504/34 of the Indian Penal Code.

3. The learned counsel for the petitioners submits that the present application was filed for quashing of the FIR but after investigation, a charge sheet has been submitted and Patna High Court CR.
MISC. No.10597 of 2021(7) dt.02-02-2026 cognizance has been taken.

sentences.text: In view of the change of stage and submission of the charge-sheet, I am not inclined to consider the prayer of the petitioners for quashing of the FIR at this stage.
5. Accordingly, this application is dismissed with liberty to the petitioners to raise all the grounds at an appropriate stage.

6. Let a copy of this order be communicated to the Principal District & Sessions Judge, Muzaffarpur through FAX for its compliance forthwith.
